fusions.name: Closing Lattice
fusions.desc: Grows a 6-tile lattice of stinging coral ahead of you for 4 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 12 damage to each one it catches, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Shooting the Bolt
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. You drive a spicule into an enemy up to 6 tiles away for 8 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, with a 50% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: The Door Still Shuts
fusions.desc: Grows a ring of coral bars at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 18 damage and is [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: No Gap Between Bars
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. Your armour rises by 6%.
